scope: 8 deterministic neighboring t-5/current pairs per val/test sequence where available; post-results descriptive analysis.
method: ORB on GT-excluded background; partial-affine RANSAC; >=12 inliers and >=50% inlier ratio. Phase correlation is supplemental and does not establish rigid camera stillness.
limitation: Estimated apparent background motion, not calibrated camera motion. Low-texture scenes can be unmeasurable; no extrapolation to unsampled frames.
